text:
ashley: Quick postmortem follow-up. Uploader noise + cascading dedupe created repeated pages. We need a short-term suppression playbook + concrete owners for the next two weeks.

tomas: I can own the suppression playbook draft. Proposal: map suppression level to alert class (noise, perf, customer-impact). For noise: 30s suppression + 12m rolling dedupe, for perf/customer-impact: no suppression. Will sketch config and tests. ETA: Thu.

rachel: I'll run historical replays against last 30 days to measure change in page volume. I'll supply a delta table (pages/day, unique incidents/day, false_positive_ratio). ETA: Tue AM.

amir: For dedupe keys: prefer `service+job+region+bucket+error_code` — don't collapse across tiers. Also add an opt-out label `no_suppress=true` for critical flows. I'll implement in alert-router and add unit tests. ETA: Wed EOD.

olga: Paging policy tweak: only escalate to human oncall when either (A) >=2 regions affected within 10m OR (B) same group fires 3x in 15m. Also add a 20m per-responder backoff to avoid repeated rings. I'll update policy doc and the pager duty integration. ETA: Fri noon.

sre-bot: Note: existing suppression rule currently uses `instance` as group key. This will change behavior for ~18 alerts. Recommend we run a 48h canary.

ashley: Good call. Let's do a canary + rollback rule: route 15% of traffic to the new suppression config for 48h. Revert if pages_per_min_canary > control by 25% AND customer_error_rate change < 3%.

tomas: I'll add the canary orchestration and an auto-revert play in the runbook.

rachel: For replay, I'll produce two artifacts: (1) per-alert violin plots showing frequency change, (2) a table with TP/FP heuristics.

amir: Implementation notes I'll include in PR: example group_key expression, sample suppression YAML, and a short simulation script. Group key example: `{{service}}:{{job}}:{{region}}:{{bucket}}:{{code}}`

olga: Acceptance criteria for merge: 1) automated replay shows >=35% reduction in pages for noisy alerts without increasing customer_error_rate > 4%; 2) canary orchestration in place; 3) runbook updated and reviewed.

ashley: Owners recap (confirm): Tomas — suppression playbook + canary orchestration (Thu). Rachel — historical replay + metrics (Tue AM). Amir — router + dedupe key impl + tests (Wed EOD). Olga — paging policy + PD integration + acceptance signoff (Fri noon).

tomas: confirmed.

rachel: confirmed. I'll post replay artifacts here.

amir: confirmed.

oncall-bot: Calendar event: "Alert suppression canary review" Wed 16:00 UTC in #eng-oncall. Reminder 30m.

ashley: Great — paste PR links + replay dashboards here when ready. We'll do a short decision window after the canary. :white_check_mark:
